description: This file contains utility functions for weather data processing, including conversion of weather codes, mapping forecast data to daily forecast objects, generating clothing tips based on forecast, and mock functions for popular places in a city. It also imports models from the project's src.api.main module.

classes.name: DailyForecast
classes.description: Data class representing daily weather forecast details.

classes.name: ClothingRecommendation
classes.description: Data class representing clothing tips for a specific day.

classes.name: PopularPlace
classes.description: Data class representing information about a popular place in a city.

methods.name: str _weathercode_to_condition(code: int)
methods.description: Maps a weather code to a human-readable weather condition string.

methods.name: List[DailyForecast] map_open_meteo_to_daily_forecast(data: Dict)
methods.description: Converts Open-Meteo API forecast data into a list of DailyForecast objects.

methods.name: List[str] _clothing_tips_for_day(day: DailyForecast)
methods.description: Generates clothing tips for a given day's forecast based on temperature, precipitation, and weather conditions.

methods.name: List[ClothingRecommendation] get_clothing_recommendations_for_forecast(forecast: List[DailyForecast])
methods.description: Produces clothing recommendations for each day based on a list of DailyForecast objects.

methods.name: List[PopularPlace] mock_popular_places_for_city(city: str, country: str)
methods.description: Provides a mocked list of popular places for a specified city, with default data if city is not in predefined samples.
